AbilityDef.label: encourage larger body
AbilityDef.description: A moral guide encourages an adult colonist to prefer a larger body. Has three times the influence of an ordinary body discussion, using Social skill, rapport and the recipient's conviction. A receptive conversation shifts their preferred range; a breakthrough updates their wishes more strongly. The recipient may resist or become irritated. Both directions share a three-day cooldown and count toward ordinary discussion limits. Bedbound guides can receive a visitor.
